name: Metallic Hydrogen Ingot
lore: Hydrogen crushed until it conducts like a metal. Metastable, probably.

name: Cosmic Neutronium Ingot
lore: Neutronium compressed with dark matter in a star's heart. Starlight drifts through it.

name: Crystalline Matrix Ingot
lore: Lattices pinned in place by the light of two dead stars.

name: Anti-Iron Ingot
lore: Anti-iron, refined in levitation. Its surface never touches the mould.

name: Theory of Everything
lore: Quantum fields, gravity, strings and the Standard Model in one equation. It fits on a T-shirt.

name: Omnilex
lore: Control over every law and every universe. While you carry it, gravity is merely a suggestion.

name: Higgs Catalyst
lore: A pinned Higgs-field bubble. Required (not consumed) by mass-altering processes.

name: Tesseract Core
lore: A hypercube's 3D shadow, rotating through a direction you cannot point to.

name: Einstein Field Core
lore: Matter tells spacetime how to curve; spacetime tells matter how to move. Both halves, in one core.

name: Annihilation Core
lore: A controlled matter-antimatter reaction in a box.

name: Multiverse Shard
lore: Matter from a universe with slightly different constants. Its colour will not settle.
